subject: Banking
title: Central Banks in Emerging Markets
description: A quick win: understand Central Banks in Emerging Markets.

hook.text: Nigeria, Argentina, and Turkey battled inflation above 50% while their central banks fought to maintain credibility.

buildup.text: Emerging market central banks face unique pressures: volatile currencies, capital flight, and political interference.

discovery.text: Many hold large dollar reserves to defend their currency.

twist.text: Argentina has had 10 currencies since 1970. Each new one was the central bank admitting the previous currency failed.

climax.text: Central banking in emerging markets is a constant fight for credibility. Without trust, no monetary tool works.

punchline.text: 10 currencies in 50 years. Argentina shows what happens when trust collapses.

quiz.question: How many different currencies has Argentina had since 1970?
